Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 40 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Siya - 8 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Ayaan - 12 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
5. Savitri - 74 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Anita and Ayaan stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal walks across the courtyard.]

Anita: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal runs to Mother.]

Kunal (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Kunal tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Ayaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Anita: "Yes, all right."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Kunal: "How beautiful!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Anita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
